page_title: WOL 1-4 MNU | Wolves v Manchester Utd 08/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+9' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Ladislav Krejci (Wolves) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar.
90+6' This is a yellow card! Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
90+4' What a chance that is! Fernando Lopez (Wolves) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar.
90+2' Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
90' 9 additional min. will be played.
86' Substitution. Ki-Jana Hoever makes way for Jackson Tchatchoua (Wolves).
85' The game has come to an end for Mason Mount. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United).
84' It's time for a substitution. Patrick Dorgu comes on in place of Diogo Dalot (Manchester United).
82' 1 - 4 Goal! Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Sam Johnstone into the bottom left corner.
82' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is going to take the penalty!
81' The referee is firm and issues Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) a deserved yellow card.
81' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Manchester Utd!
80' Referee Michael Salisbury makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Manchester Utd. Let’s see what happens!
80' Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
79' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
79' Corner kick. Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is ready to send the ball into the box.
78' Ruben Amorim has decided to make a change. Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) replaces Casemiro.

78' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the free kick from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) on the edge of the box. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Manchester Utd.
77' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position, just outside the box.

76' Ladislav Krejci (Wolves) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Michael Salisbury has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Manchester Utd win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
75' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Sam Johnstone, who smothers the ball.
74' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Wolves, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
74' Michael Salisbury couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Casemiro (Manchester United) and blew his whistle. Wolves will take a free kick.
73' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
70' Toti goes off the pitch and Hugo Bueno (Wolves) comes on.
70' The substitution is prepared. Matheus Mane joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jhon Arias (Wolves).
69' That will be all from Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare.
69' Substitution. Ayden Heaven (Manchester United) walks off the pitch and Leny Yoro comes on as a substitute.
69' The referee signals a substitution. Lisandro Martinez is brought on as a substitute for Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United).

67' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot low towards the middle of the net is denied by Sam Johnstone. This effort didn't really trouble him.
66' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) works the corner short.
66' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. Manchester Utd win a corner kick.
65' Andre (Wolves) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
65' Mason Mount (Manchester United) tackles a bit over-zealously and Michael Salisbury blows for a foul.

62' 1 - 3 Mason Mount (Manchester United) meets a perfect cross from Bruno Fernandes deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike inside the right post. The score is 1:3.

62' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
61' Flag goes up against Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
60' The linesman raises his flag. Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) is adjudged offside.

59' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
57' Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
54' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Jean-Ricner Bellegarde limps off the pitch to be replaced by Fernando Lopez (Wolves).
52' Looks like Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
51' 1 - 2 Goal! Diogo Dalot passes the ball to the feet of Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 1:2.
49' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

49' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. Manchester Utd force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
48' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
47' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
46' Ladislav Krejci (Wolves) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' Michael Salisbury has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+2' 1 - 1 Goal! Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) shows good awareness inside the box as he latches on to a brilliant pass and fires a first-time shot inside the right post. David Moller Wolfe assisted in the goal. 1:1.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
41' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the right post.
39' Andre (Wolves) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
38' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) was quite harsh and Michael Salisbury didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
38' The corner from Amad Diallo (Manchester United) is hurriedly cleared.

37' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The ball is out of play. Manchester Utd will have a chance to score from a corner.
37' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes it short.
36' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
36' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Manchester Utd have been awarded a corner kick.
33' David Moller Wolfe (Wolves) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
32' The game is interrupted as Jhon Arias (Wolves) is flagged offside.
29' A rebound falls to Amad Diallo (Manchester United) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post.

29' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick low strike towards the middle of the goal that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a superb goal-line clearance.

29' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) was presented with a great chance after a cross found him all alone in the box, but his low effort towards the middle of the goal lacked pace and was comfortably saved by Sam Johnstone.
25' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Matheus Cunha tees up Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom right corner and past Sam Johnstone.

24' Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Michael Salisbury blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
22' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
19' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.

19' Mason Mount (Manchester United) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
18' Poor challenge! Andre (Wolves) is penalised for tripping and Michael Salisbury blows his whistle.
15' Andre (Wolves) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
14' A cross into the box from Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) is cleared. Good work from Wolves as they win a corner.
13' Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) is able to continue to play.
11' Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
11' Referee Michael Salisbury sees the trip by Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
10' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

10' Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Manchester Utd.
9' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range towards the middle of the goal, but Sam Johnstone was alert and made an amazing save!
9' Manchester Utd take a short corner kick.

8' CHANCE! Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) goes very close! He gathers a cross inside the box and fires a sublime shot towards the right side of the goal, but Sam Johnstone produces an excellent save. Now Manchester Utd have a corner.
7' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
5' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) whips in a cross from the corner, but Sam Johnstone is well positioned and punches the ball away.
4' David Moller Wolfe (Wolves) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
3' Andre (Wolves) picks up a loose pass and unexpectedly unleashes a howitzer from distance, but the effort comes to nothing as a defender gets in the block.
1' The first half has started.
Manchester Utd will kick-off.
Michael Salisbury will referee today's match.
